channel.title: Olive Oil Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Olive Oil Times (oliveoiltimes.com)

item.title: Australia and New Zealand Producers Warn Health Star Ratings Could Undercut Olive Oil Messaging
item.description: With Health Star Ratings set to become mandatory, olive oil producers say the algorithm penalizes extra virgin olive oil and overlooks compounds linked to its health benefits.

item.title: Sustainable, Low-Cost Process Turns Olive Pomace Into Nutrient-Rich Sheep Feed
item.description: Researchers and farmers in Tuscany are testing a low-cost process that pairs moist olive pomace with absorbent brewer’s grain to create digestible silage for sheep.

item.title: Orthodox Monastery Earns Three Gold Awards at NYIOOC for Bosnia and Herzegovina
item.description: A Serbian Orthodox monastery in southern Herzegovina won three Gold Awards at the NYIOOC, adding to Bosnia and Herzegovina’s growing list of recognitions at the world’s largest olive oil quality contest.

item.title: Gold Award Marks a Standout NYIOOC Debut for Jaén Picual
item.description: Pago de Espejo earned a Gold Award at the 2026 NYIOOC, with co-owner Rosario Minchón Espejo crediting early harvesting, careful milling and a focus on balance for the debut win.

item.title: Inside Séka Hills’ Quality-First Approach in California’s Capay Valley
item.description: Séka Hills won one Gold and four Silver Awards at the 2026 NYIOOC, with its Coratina earning top honors. The Capay Valley estate credited cool harvest conditions and a long-term focus on quality and land stewardship.

item.title: Early Harvest Signals Record Year in Brazil’s Minas Gerais
item.description: Olive growers in Brazil’s Minas Gerais say an early harvest, strong flowering and favorable winter conditions are setting the stage for a record year, even as heavy summer rains shape quality and milling decisions.

item.title: Italy’s Organic Food Market Nears €7 Billion as Demand Outpaces Supply
item.description: A new report says organic is expanding in Italy, but organic extra virgin olive oil remains a niche.

item.title: EU-India Trade Pact Could Lower Barriers for Greek Olive Oil Exports
item.description: A new EU-India free trade agreement could phase out India’s steep olive oil import duties over five years, potentially narrowing the price gap for consumers.

item.title: Mandranova Blends Hospitality and Olive Oil Craft in Southern Sicily
item.description: The family-run estate near Palma di Montechiaro pairs olive groves and almond orchards with 15 guest rooms and a private villa, offering visitors a closer look at how award-winning extra virgin olive oil is made.

item.title: How Extra Virgin Olive Oil Can Become America’s Default Kitchen Fat
item.description: Updated U.S. dietary guidance has put extra virgin olive oil in the spotlight, but experts say the biggest health gains come when it replaces other fats as the default choice for everyday cooking.
